name: stellar_spectroscopy_from_scratch
description: A multi-lecture, build-from-scratch course that rebuilds a synthetic stellar spectrum from first principles — equation of state, opacity, and radiative transfer — in short, readable NumPy, with **every step benchmarked against [pykurucz](https://github.com/tingyuansen/pykurucz)** (a pure-Python ATLAS12 & SYNTHE) until the from-scratch flux matches the production code to machine precision.
